blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong multimodal capabilities but remain vulnerable to backdoors implanted through poisoned fine-tuning data. Existing defenses often require extensive parameter updates during fine-tuning or incur per-query overhead during inference. To address these limitations, we propose Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR), a post-training defense that performs sparse updates to the projection interface and introduces no additional computation during inference. We reveal that backdoored VLM projectors are substantially more sensitive to bounded perturbations than clean VLM projectors, a phenomenon we term projection fragility . Building on this finding, PSR identifies the output channels most sensitive to perturbations in each projection layer of a backdoored VLM and restores their parameters to the corresponding pretrained values. Experiments across multiple tasks show that PSR reduces attack success rates to near zero while preserving clean-task performance.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型显示出强大的多模式能力,但仍易受通过有毒微调数据植入的后门的影响。 现有防御在微调时往往需要大量参数更新,或者在推论期间需要每平方平方平方平方平方平方平方平方平. 为解决这些局限性,我们提议Perturb-Select-Restore(PSR),即训练后防御,对投影界面进行零星更新,并在推论中不引入额外的计算. 我们揭示,后门VLM投影仪对有界扰动的敏感度大大高于干净的VLM投影仪,我们称之为“脆弱性”现象。 基于这一发现,PSR识别出后门VLM每个投影层中最敏感于扰动的输出通道,并把它们的参数还原为相应的被预导值. 跨越多个任务的实验表明,PSR在保持清洁任务性能的同时将攻击成功率降低到接近于零.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) connect a visual encoder to a large language model through a lightweight visual-to-language projection interface ( Dai et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . This modular design enables efficient adaptation to a broad range of multimodal tasks by fine-tuning only the projection interface while keeping the visual encoder and language model frozen. However, fine-tuning on untrusted data exposes VLMs to backdoor attacks: an adversary can inject a small number of poisoned samples, causing the adapted VLM to behave normally on clean inputs yet produce attacker-specified responses whenever a visual trigger appears at inference time ( Chen et al., 2017 ; Gu et al., 2019 ) . Recent work has demonstrated the vulnerability of VLMs to backdoors involving diverse trigger types ( Lyu et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)通过轻量级视觉-语言投影界面将视觉编码器与大型语言模型相接(Dai等,2023;Liu等,2024;Zhu等,2024;Bai等,2025.). 这种模块化设计能够通过仅微调投影接口而同时使视觉编码器和语言模型被冻结来高效地适应广泛的多模式任务. 然而,对不可信数据的微调使VLMs暴露出后门攻击:对手可以注入少量被毒取的样本,使被改造的VLM在清洁输入物上表现正常,但当可视触发物在推断时出现时会产生攻击者指定的反应(Chen等,2017;Gu等,2019). 最近的工作表明,VLMs对涉及不同触发类型的后门的脆弱性(Lyu等,2024;Lyu等,2025)。

blocks.en: Existing VLM backdoor defenses mainly operate during the fine-tuning or inference phases ( Rong et al., 2025 ; Xun et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , thereby requiring either extensive parameter updates or additional per-query computation. General post-training backdoor defenses ( Liu et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019 ; Wu and Wang, 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) can enable efficient model repair, but were primarily developed for image classifiers rather than VLMs. Applying them directly to VLM projection layers can be inefficient or harmful to clean utility when performance depends on preserving vision-language alignment.
blocks.zh: 现有的VLM后门防御主要在微调或推论阶段运行(Rong等,2025;Xun等,2025;Jiang等,2026;Xu等,2026;Zhang等,2026),因此需要大量参数更新或额外的每克计算. 一般训练后后后门防御(刘等,2018;王等,2019;吴和王等,2021;郑等,2022;李等,2023;林等,2024)可以实现高效模型修复,但主要是为图像分类器而非VLM所开发. 当性能依赖于维护视觉语言的对齐时,直接将其应用于VLM投影层可能效率低下或有害于清洁的效用.

blocks.en: To explore whether post-training purification is feasible for VLM projection interfaces, we begin by testing whether backdoored projection interfaces exhibit distinctive sensitivity to perturbations. We conduct controlled probes on clean and backdoored LLaVA-1.5 projectors across COCO and VQAv2. For each sample, we apply temporary multiplicative perturbations to the projector parameters and optimize them via projected sign-gradient ascent to maximize the task loss under teacher forcing. The model parameters remain fixed during this procedure, and the optimized perturbations are discarded after each sample. For each projector, we compute the perturbation-induced loss increase, Δ ​ L = L adv − L base \Delta L=L_{\mathrm{adv}}-L_{\mathrm{base}} , where L base L_{\mathrm{base}} is that projector’s own unperturbed loss. We compare these loss increases across projectors at each fixed perturbation budget ϵ \epsilon . Further implementation details are provided in Appendix B.1 . Figure 1 shows the resulting loss increases for clean projectors and projectors backdoored by BadNet, Blended, or TrojVLM. In both tasks, all three backdoored projectors become more sensitive than the clean projector as the perturbation budget increases. We refer to this phenomenon as projection fragility .

blocks.en: Although this observation provides a useful signal for purification, the diverse and multi-layered structure of VLM projection interfaces makes it challenging to design an efficient and broadly applicable method. To address this challenge, we introduce Perturb-Select-Restore (PSR), a post-training purification method. Given a backdoored VLM, PSR identifies and repairs suspicious output channels in the target projection layers. It first perturbs these channels within a bounded range and learns robustness scores. It then selects a fixed fraction of the lowest-scoring channels separately in each layer. Finally, it restores the selected channels using the corresponding pretrained weights and biases. This layer-wise channel repair reduces computation, handles different sensitivity distributions across layers, and better preserves clean vision-language performance than direct pruning.
blocks.zh: 虽然这一观测为净化提供了有用的信号,但VLM投影接口的多样多层结构使得设计高效而广泛适用的方法具有挑战性. 为了应对这一挑战,我们采用了Perturb-Select-Restore(PSR),一种训练后净化方法. 鉴于一个后门VLM,PSR识别并修复了目标投影层中的可疑输出通道. 它首先扰动这些频道在一个有界限的范围内,并学习稳健的分数. 然后在每个层中分别选择最低得分的频道的固定分数. 最后,它利用相应的预先训练的权重和偏差来恢复所选择的通道. 这种分层的通道修补减少了计算,处理不同层层间的敏感度分布,比起直接穿透,更能保存干净的视觉语言性能.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • A clean-data signal for backdoor purification. We identify projection fragility: backdoored VLMs exhibit larger clean-loss increases under projection perturbations than clean VLMs, providing a signal for channel selection. • A channel-wise post-training purification method. PSR learns channel-wise robustness scores to identify backdoor-associated projection output channels and restores their parameters to the corresponding pretrained values. • Strong empirical results across diverse settings. Experiments across multiple tasks show that PSR reduces attack success rates to near zero while preserving clean-task performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Backdoor attacks on vision-language models. Backdoor attacks were first studied extensively in image classification, where an attacker poisons training data so that a model predicts an attacker-chosen target when a trigger is present ( Chen et al., 2017 ; Gu et al., 2019 ) . In vision-language settings, triggers can be implemented through different visual transformations, ranging from explicit patch or blended patterns ( Chen et al., 2017 ; Gu et al., 2019 ) to spatially warped or sample-specific invisible perturbations ( Li et al., 2021 ; Nguyen and Tran, 2021 ) . These attacks transfer effectively to VLMs ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . More recent work has introduced attacks specifically designed for them: TrojVLM injects backdoors during instruction tuning while preserving caption quality on clean images ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) , and VLOOD demonstrates that backdoors can be implanted using only out-of-distribution auxiliary data ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) . Domain-shift studies further indicate that VLM backdoors can remain effective across mismatched training and testing domains ( Liang et al., 2025 ) . These results motivate defenses that suppress backdoor behavior within the model rather than only filtering obvious input triggers.
blocks.zh: 后门攻击视觉语言模型. 后门攻击最早在图像分类中被广泛研究,攻击者会毒害训练数据,使模型预测在有触发器时攻击者选择的目标(Chen等,2017;Gu等,2019). 在视觉语言设置中,触发器可以通过不同的视觉转变来实施,从明显的补丁或混合模式(Chen等,2017;Gu等,2019)到空间扭曲或特定样本的隐形扰动(Li等,2021;Nguyen和Tran等,2021. 这些攻击有效转移到了VLMs(梁等,2025.). 最近的工作引入了专门针对他们的攻击: TrojVLM在指导调试时注入后门,同时保留了清洁图像上的标题质量(Lyu等,2024年),而VLOOD表明后门只能使用分流外辅助数据植入(Lyu等,2025年). 域间转移研究还表明,VLM后门在不匹配的培训和测试领域仍然有效(梁等,2025年)。 这些结果激励了在模型内压制后门行为的防御,而不只是过滤出明显的输入触发.

blocks.en: Backdoor defenses for vision-language models. VLM-specific defenses can be broadly categorized into training-time and test-time approaches. Training-time methods either identify and remove poisoned samples before adaptation or regularize the adapted parameters to suppress backdoor triggers. For example, BYE detects suspicious samples in VLM fine-tuning using attention-based signals and clustering ( Rong et al., 2025 ) , while RobustIT regularizes adapter fine-tuning to reduce trigger effects ( Xun et al., 2025 ) . Test-time methods, including PurMM, SRD, and CleanSight, intervene in the input or model computation during inference ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Training-time methods require intervention during adaptation, whereas test-time methods introduce per-query overhead. In contrast, PSR purifies VLM projection weights after training without modifying the adaptation process or adding inference-time computation.
blocks.zh: 后门为视觉语言模型作防御. 与VLM有关的防御可以大致分为训练时间和试验时间两种方法. 培训时间方法要么在适应前识别并去除被中毒的样品,要么使适应参数规范化以抑制后门触发. 例如,BYE通过基于注意力的信号和集群检测出VLM微调中的可疑样本(Rong等,2025年),而RobustIT则将适配器微调规范化以降低触发效应(Xun等,2025年). 试验时间方法,包括PurMM,SRD,和CleanSight,在推论中干预输入或模型计算(Jiang等,2026;徐等,2026;张等,2026). 培训时间方法要求在适应期间进行干预,而测试时间方法则引入了每平流层的间接费用。 相比之下,PSR在经过培训后纯化了VLM的预测权重,而没有修改适应过程或增加推论时间计算.

blocks.en: General post-training backdoor defenses. Post-training backdoor defenses based on neurons, channels, representations, or weight dynamics provide important technical foundations for PSR. Pruning methods remove backdoor-related components based on various criteria: Fine-Pruning removes neurons dormant on clean data ( Liu et al., 2018 ) , Neural Cleanse detects anomalous triggers and applies pruning ( Wang et al., 2019 ) , and ANP prunes neurons sensitive to adversarial perturbations on clean data ( Wu and Wang, 2021 ) . Channel-level methods such as CLP apply Lipschitzness-based criteria ( Zheng et al., 2022 ) . Other methods use unlearning-based signals to locate backdoor-related components, including RNP and TSBD ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) . Spectral Signatures detects poisoned samples via anomalous representation directions ( Tran et al., 2018 ) . However, because these defenses were not specifically designed for VLMs, their direct application may yield suboptimal performance; in contrast, PSR is tailored to the distinctive architectural characteristics of VLMs, making it better suited for backdoor mitigation in this setting.
blocks.zh: 一般训练后后门防御. 基于神经元,通道,表达或重量动态的训练后后后门防御为PSR提供了重要的技术基础. Pruning方法根据各种标准去除后门相关成分: Fine-Pruning去除在清洁数据上休眠的神经元(刘等,2018年). Neural Cleanse能检测出异常触发并应用出普鲁士(Wang等,2019年),而ANP能检测出对清洁数据的对抗性扰动敏感的神经元(Wu和Wang等,2021年). CLP等频道级方法适用以Lipschitzness为基础的标准(郑等,2022.). 其他方法使用不学习信号定位后门相关组件,包括RNP和TSBD(Li等,2023;Lin等,2024.). 光谱 签名通过异常表达指示检测出中毒样本(Tran等,2018.) . 然而,由于这些防御不是专门为VLM设计的,其直接应用可能会产生不尽人意的性能;相形之下,PSR是针对VLM的特有建筑特点而定制的,使得它更适合在此情况下进行后门缓解.

4 Methodology
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: Overview. PSR is a three-stage post-training purification procedure, illustrated in Figure 2 . Starting from a backdoored projector ϕ b \phi_{b} , it introduces a channel-wise robustness-score vector 𝜽 \bm{\theta} and bounded auxiliary perturbations 𝜹 \bm{\delta} at each target projection layer. Using only clean calibration data, PSR alternates between maximizing the clean loss over 𝜹 \bm{\delta} to expose sensitivity and minimizing a regularized clean-loss objective over 𝜽 \bm{\theta} , while keeping the model parameters frozen. Channels that are more vulnerable under this perturbation probe exert stronger pressure for their robustness scores to decrease, so the smallest learned 𝜽 \bm{\theta} values identify the channels most likely to contain backdoor-related changes. PSR selects a fixed fraction of these channels independently in each layer, restores their weight rows and bias entries from ϕ 0 \phi_{0} , and leaves all other adapted parameters unchanged. This perturb-select-restore procedure concentrates the repair on fragile channels while preserving task-relevant adaptation elsewhere in the projection interface.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Victim models and benchmarks. We conduct experiments on two VLM architectures and two multimodal benchmarks. The evaluated models are Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , which uses a visual merger together with DeepStack modules as its visual-to-language projection interface, and LLaVA-1.5-7B ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , which uses a two-layer MLP projector. The evaluated tasks are image captioning on MS-COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ; Chen et al., 2015 ) and visual question answering on VQAv2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) ; each model is evaluated on both tasks. In all settings, the backdoor is implanted by parameter-efficient adaptation of the visual-to-language projection interface while the visual encoder and language model remain fixed. Appendix A.1 gives the model and target-layer details, while Appendix A.2 describes the datasets and evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 受害者模式和基准。 我们进行两个VLM架构和两个多式联运基准的试验。 被评价的模型有:Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (Bai等,2025年),使用可视化并联与DeepStack模块作为可视化到语言的投影界面;LLaVA-1.5-7B (Liu等,2024年),使用双层MLP投影仪. 被评价的任务有:MS-COCO上的图像字幕(Lin等,2014;Chen等,2015)和VQAv2上的视觉问题回答(Goyal等,2017);每个模型对两个任务进行评价. 在所有设置中,后门由可视化到语言投影接口的参数高效改造所植入,而可视化编码器和语言模型则保持不变. 附录A.1给出了模型和目标层的细节,而附录A.2描述了数据集和评价协议.

blocks.en: Backdoor setup. Following prior VLM backdoor evaluations, we consider six attack constructions: BadNet ( Gu et al., 2019 ) , Blended ( Chen et al., 2017 ) , ISSBA ( Li et al., 2021 ) , WaNet ( Nguyen and Tran, 2021 ) , TrojVLM ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) , and VLOOD ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) . All attacks use the target response “you have been hacked lol.” Appendix A.3 describes the trigger mechanisms and target-injection strategies for these attacks.
blocks.zh: 后门设所. 在先前的VLM后门评价之后,我们考虑6个攻击构造: BadNet (Gu等, 2019年), Blended (Chen等, 2017年), ISSBA (Li等, 2021年),WaNet (Nguyen和Tran, 2021年), TrojVLM (Lyu等人,2024年),和VLOOD(Lyu等人,2025年). 所有攻击都使用目标响应“你已经被黑入了Lol”。 附录A.3描述了这些袭击的触发机制和目标注射策略.

blocks.en: Defense baselines. We compare PSR with Clean Fine-tuning (Clean FT), a conventional clean-data repair baseline, and three post-training channel-selection baselines: Random, Fine-Pruning-style (FP) ( Liu et al., 2018 ) , and CLP-style (CLP) ( Zheng et al., 2022 ) . Random selects channels uniformly at random within each target layer. We focus on these methods because they can be evaluated under PSR’s defender setting, starting from the same fine-tuned poisoned model and performing model-level repair before deployment. For a controlled comparison, the channel-selection baselines rank the same target channels and restore the same number per layer from ϕ 0 \phi_{0} . We also report the undefended poisoned model as a no-defense reference. Detailed scoring rules and comparison protocols are provided in Appendix A.4 .

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We report attack success rate (ASR, ↓ \downarrow ), which measures the proportion of triggered inputs whose generated output contains the target response, and clean utility (CU, ↑ \uparrow ), measured by CIDEr ( Vedantam et al., 2015 ) for image captioning and official VQA accuracy for visual question answering. Lower ASR indicates more effective backdoor mitigation, while higher CU indicates better preservation of clean-task performance.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Tables 2 and 2 report results across two VLM architectures, two multimodal tasks, and six attack constructions. PSR reduces ASR to at most 1.70% in every evaluated setting, showing that the perturbation-based channel scores consistently identify projection channels associated with the backdoor.
blocks.zh: 表2和表2报告在两个VLM架构、两个多模式任务和六个攻击建筑方面的结果。 PSR在每个被评价的设置中将ASR降低到最多为1.70%,表明以扰动为主的信道分数一致地识别出与后门相联的投影道.

blocks.en: Existing defenses are not consistently reliable. Clean FT removes some attacks but leaves the backdoor largely intact in many cases: on COCO, it leaves ASR above 91% for TrojVLM and VLOOD on both models, and on LLaVA VQAv2 it leaves 99.86% on BadNet and 99.96% on TrojVLM. Its occasional successes can also coincide with severe utility collapse, such as Qwen3-VL on VQAv2 under WaNet, where ASR falls to 0.00% but CU drops from 80.43% to 0.20%. Channel-selection baselines are more effective on individual attacks but vary substantially across models and datasets. For example, CLP leaves 45.24% ASR on Qwen3-VL COCO under WaNet and 18.70% on Qwen3-VL VQAv2 under Blended, while Random and FP leave 67.82% and 40.00% on TrojVLM COCO, respectively. No single baseline therefore provides the reliable cross-setting suppression achieved by PSR.
blocks.zh: 现有辩护不一贯可靠. 清洁的FT可以去除一些攻击,但在很多情况下留下了基本上完好无损的后门:在COCO上,在TrojVLM和VLOOD两种模型上,ASR都高于91%;在LLaVA VQAv2上,BadNet上为99.86%;在TrojVLM上为99.96%。 它偶尔的成功也可能与严重的公用设施倒闭同时发生,例如WaNet下VQAv2上的Qune3-VL,ASR下降至0.0%,而CU则从80.43%下降到0.20%. 频道选择基线对个别攻击更有效,但模型和数据集差异很大。 例如,CLP在WaNet下的Quen3-VL COCO上留下了45.24%的ASR,在WaNet下的Quen3-VL VQAv2上留下了18.70%的ASR. 混合,而Random和FP在TrojVLM COCO上分别留下67.82%和40.00%. 因此,没有一个单一的基准能够提供PSR实现的可靠的交叉设定抑制.

blocks.en: PSR preserves clean utility while suppressing the backdoor. On LLaVA COCO, PSR reduces ASR to at most 1.60% across all attacks, including 0.00% on ISSBA, while retaining CIDEr values between 120.55 and 122.93. On Qwen3-VL COCO, it achieves 0.00% ASR on ISSBA and VLOOD and 0.04% on WaNet, with CIDEr remaining between 123.03 and 127.30. The same pattern holds for VQAv2: PSR keeps ASR below 1.40% on LLaVA and below 0.62% on Qwen3-VL. Clean accuracy remains close to that of the undefended models in most settings, with CU around 73–75% for LLaVA and 80% for Qwen3-VL. Overall, PSR is effective across both the compact MLP projector and the distributed merger interface, demonstrating its consistency across different projection architectures.
blocks.zh: PSR在压制后门的同时保持了干净的效用. 在LLaVA COCO上,PSR在所有攻击中将ASR降为最多为1.60%,包括国际空间站的0.0%,同时将CIDER值保持在120.55至122.93之间. 在Qwen3-VL CO上,它在ISSBA和VLOOD上实现了0.0%的ASR和在WaNet上实现了0.04%的ASR,CIDEr保持在123.03到127.30之间. VQAv2:PSR将LLAVA的ASR保持在1.40%以下,Qune3-VL的ASR保持在0.62%以下. 清洁精度仍然接近大多数场合的无防守模型,LLaVA的CU为73-75%左右,Qune3-VL为80%. 总体而言,PSR在紧凑的MLP投影器和分布式并购接口上都有效,显示了它在不同投影架构上的一致性.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: All ablation experiments use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on COCO under four attacks: BadNet, TrojVLM, Blended, and WaNet. Unless noted, we use the standard PSR configuration.
blocks.zh: 所有通融实验都使用Qwen3-VL-8B-指令来进行COCO在4个攻击下:BadNet,TrojVLM,Blended,和WaNet. 除非注明,否则我们使用标准的PSR配置.

blocks.en: Restoration ratio. Figure 3 varies the restoration ratio from 10% to 50% with fixed robustness scores. Across attacks, increasing the restoration ratio consistently lowers ASR, although the rate of reduction varies by attack, while clean CIDEr declines gradually. This result characterizes the security–utility trade-off controlled by the restoration-ratio hyperparameter. At r = 100 % r=100\% all target channels are restored, so the projection reverts to the pretrained base VLM: ASR is 0.00% for all four attacks, but clean CIDEr drops to 68.84 versus 123.03–126.09 at r = 30 % r=30\% .

Layer coverage. Table 3 compares repairing the first and second MLP layer groups across the merger modules, separately and jointly, under the corresponding settings. When only one MLP layer group is restored, channel robustness scores are learned only for that group across the main merger and the three DeepStack mergers. Restoring only the first group leaves 82.74–97.52% ASR, and restoring only the second leaves 31.30–67.02% ASR; jointly restoring both groups reduces ASR to 0.04–1.70% across all four attacks. blocks.en: 5.4 Robustness to Adaptive Attacks
blocks.zh: 5.4 适应性攻击的力度

blocks.en: We finally evaluate PSR against adaptive adversaries who know the defense and adjust attack training to evade it. We extend the adversary in Section 3.1 with full knowledge of PSR, including its channel-wise parameterization, the bounded perturbation probe, and the base-guided restoration from ϕ 0 \phi_{0} ; the adversary controls the fine-tuning data and optimization procedure and may embed a simulation of PSR into attack training. Starting from the standard attack objective, we consider three adaptive strategies of increasing strength.

Perturbation-aware training (PA). The adversary replays PSR’s perturbation probe during attack training: bounded channel perturbations are optimized to increase the clean loss, and the attack objective is augmented with a clean-data term computed under these perturbations, so that the poisoned projector is trained to stay insensitive to the probe that PSR relies on for channel selection.
blocks.zh: 扰动意识训练(PA). 对手在攻击训练中重放PSR的扰动探测器:被限制的信道扰动被优化以增加清洁损失,攻击目标被增加一个在这些扰动下计算的干净数据名词,这样被中毒的投影仪被训练出对PSR所依赖的探测器保持不敏感.

blocks.en: Persistence-augmented training (PA+). Building on PA, the adversary additionally requires poisoned samples to keep producing the target response under the same perturbations, directly countering the fragility signal exposed by the probe.
blocks.zh: 持久性强化培训(PA+). 在PA的基础上,对手还另外要求中毒样品在同样的扰动下继续产生目标响应,直接对抗被探测器所暴露出的脆弱性信号.

blocks.en: Restoration-aware training (RA). The strongest adversary simulates the complete PSR procedure during training: it periodically learns channel robustness scores, mimics restoring the lowest-scoring channels toward the base parameters, and optimizes both the clean and attack objectives under this simulated restoration, so that the implanted backdoor is explicitly trained to survive the actual defense.
blocks.zh: 恢复意识培训(RA)。 最强的对手在训练中模拟完整的PSR程序:它定期学习信道稳健分数,模仿将得分最低的渠道恢复到基参数,并在这种模拟还原下优化清洁和攻击目标,这样被植入的后门被明确训练以活出实际防御.

All models are purified by PSR under the standard configuration in Section 5.1 . blocks.en: PSR remains effective under defense-aware training. Across these adaptive settings, PSR reduces ASR to near zero in most settings. These results show that training the backdoor to withstand PSR’s perturbation probe does not necessarily make it robust to the subsequent purification step.
blocks.zh: PSR在防御意识训练下依然有效. 通过这些适应性环境,PSR将大多数环境的ASR降低到接近于零. 这些结果表明,训练后门以承受PSR的扰动探测器并不一定使其坚固到后续的净化步骤.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We proposed PSR, a post-training purification method for repairing backdoored VLM visual-to-language projection interfaces. Our analysis identifies projection fragility: backdoored models exhibit disproportionately larger clean-loss increases under bounded projection perturbations, providing a clean-data signal for channel selection. PSR uses this signal to learn robustness scores and directly restores selected projection rows and biases to their corresponding values in ϕ 0 \phi_{0} , producing a purified projection interface without intervention during adaptation or at inference time. Across two VLM architectures, two multimodal tasks, and six attack types, PSR substantially suppresses the attack success rate while generally retaining clean-task utility. These results support clean-data robustness scoring and restoration to pretrained parameter values as a practical direction for mitigating projection-interface backdoors in VLMs under the evaluated threat model.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PSR,一种用于修复后门VLM视觉到语言投影界面的训练后净化方法. 我们的分析查明了投影的脆弱性:后门模型在有限度的投影扰动下显示出不成比例地更大的清洁损失增加,为频道选择提供了清洁数据信号。 PSR使用这个信号来学习强性分数,并直接将所选投影行和偏差恢复到X-0\phi_{0}中的相应值,在适应或推想时间不干预的情况下产生出纯化投影界面. 通过两个VLM架构,两个多模式任务,以及六个攻击类型,PSR在总体上保留了清洁任务效用的同时,实质上压制了攻击成功率. 这些结果支持清洁数据稳健性评分和恢复到预先训练的参数值,作为评估的威胁模型下减轻脆弱和半衰期后门的投影-相接性的实际方向。

blocks.en: A.1 Models

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ Bai et al., 2025 ] couples a high-resolution visual encoder with the Qwen3 language model. Its visual-to-language projection interface contains a visual merger and three DeepStack mergers that inject visual information at multiple depths. In our experiments, attack training updates this interface while keeping the visual encoder and language model frozen. For PSR and all comparison methods, we target the output channels of the two affine layer families in every merger. We denote these layer sets by ℒ 1 Q \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{Q}}_{1} and ℒ 2 Q \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{Q}}_{2} and use ℒ Q = ℒ 1 Q ∪ ℒ 2 Q \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{Q}}=\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{Q}}_{1}\cup\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{Q}}_{2} as the target-layer set.

blocks.en: LLaVA-1.5-7B [ Liu et al., 2024 ] uses a CLIP ViT-L/14 visual encoder with 336px input resolution, a two-layer MLP projector, and the Vicuna-7B language model. The projector is the only module updated during attack training; the visual encoder and language model remain frozen. We denote its two affine layers by ℓ 1 L \ell^{\mathrm{L}}_{1} and ℓ 2 L \ell^{\mathrm{L}}_{2} and target both layers, giving ℒ L = { ℓ 1 L , ℓ 2 L } \mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{L}}=\{\ell^{\mathrm{L}}_{1},\ell^{\mathrm{L}}_{2}\} . The two architectures therefore allow us to evaluate the same defense at the projection-interface level on LLaVA’s compact projector interface and Qwen3-VL’s distributed merger interface.

blocks.en: A.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: A.2 数据集

blocks.en: MS-COCO [ Lin et al., 2014 , Chen et al., 2015 ] is a large-scale benchmark for image understanding and captioning. It contains over 200,000 200{,}000 labeled images spanning 80 80 object categories, with five human-written captions for each image. We use the 2017 split, which contains approximately 118,000 118{,}000 training images and 5,000 5{,}000 validation images. For captioning, the model is prompted with “Describe this image in a short sentence,” and performance is measured by corpus-level CIDEr [ Vedantam et al., 2015 ] .
blocks.zh: MS-COCO [Lin等,2014年;Chen等,2015年] 是图像理解和字幕的大规模基准. 它包含超过20万200{,}000个标有标签的图像,覆盖了80个对象类别,每个图像有5个人写标题. 我们使用2017分机,其中包含约118,000 118{,}000训练图像和5,000 5{,}000验证图像. 对于标题,该模型以“用短句描述这一图像”来提示,性能由实体级的CIDEr衡量[Vedantam等,2015]。

blocks.en: VQAv2 [ Goyal et al., 2017 ] contains approximately 204,000 204{,}000 images and 1.1 1.1 million human-generated questions, each paired with ten crowd-sourced answers. Compared with VQAv1, it reduces language priors by pairing similar images with the same question but different answers, making visual evidence more important for answering. We follow the standard open-ended setting and report accuracy using the official evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: VQAv2 [Goyal等, 2017] 包含约204,000 204{,}000个图像和110万个由人类产生的问题,每个问题都有10个众源解答. 与VQAv1相比,它通过将相似的图像与相同的问题但不同的答案相配来减少语言前缀,使视觉证据对回答更为重要. 我们遵循标准的开放式设定,并利用正式评价协议报告准确性。

blocks.en: A.3 Backdoor Attacks
blocks.zh: A.3 后门袭击

blocks.en: We evaluate four established image-space trigger constructions and two attacks designed for vision-language generation. For BadNet, Blended, ISSBA, WaNet, and VLOOD, poisoned examples replace the original response with the attack target. TrojVLM instead inserts the target phrase into the original response so that the remaining content is preserved. Figure 4 shows representative triggered inputs produced from the same clean image.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四种既定的图像空间触发构造和两种针对视觉语言生成的攻击。 对于BadNet,Blended,ISSSBA,WaNet,和VLOOD来说,被毒杀的例子用攻击目标取代了最初的反应. TrojVLM转而将目标短语插入到原始响应中,以保留剩余内容. 图4显示由同一清洁图像产生的有代表性的触发投入。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Visual comparison of the six trigger types applied to the same clean image. Top row: BadNet, Blended, and ISSBA. Bottom row: WaNet, TrojVLM, and VLOOD.
blocks.zh: 图4:适用于同一种清真图像的六种触发类型可视化比较. 上行: BadNet, Blended, and ISSBA. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-02. 下行:WaNet,TrojVLM,和VLOOD.

blocks.en: BadNet [ Gu et al., 2019 ] embeds a fixed patch into the input image. The localized and visible pattern serves as the trigger for generating the target response.
blocks.zh: BadNet [Gu等,2019] 在输入图像中嵌入了固定的补丁. 局部和可见的模式是产生目标反应的导火索。

blocks.en: Blended [ Chen et al., 2017 ] linearly blends a trigger image with the clean input, producing a global low-contrast pattern that is less conspicuous than a localized patch. Following the reference implementation, we use the Hello Kitty trigger for the Blended attack.
blocks.zh: Bled [Chen等,2017] 线性地将触发图像与干净的输入相混合,产生全球低相接图案,比局部补丁不明显. 参考实施后,我们使用"Hello Kitty"触发器进行"Blend"攻击.

blocks.en: WaNet [ Nguyen and Tran, 2021 ] applies a smooth spatial deformation field to the image. The resulting geometric distortion acts as an imperceptible trigger without introducing an additive patch.
blocks.zh: WaNet [Nguyen and Tran, 2021] 对于图像应用了平滑的空间变形场. 由此而来几何扭曲在不引入添加剂补丁的情况下起到无法识别的触发作用.

blocks.en: ISSBA [ Li et al., 2021 ] uses an encoder–decoder network to embed a predefined signal into each image. This produces invisible, instance-specific triggers rather than a single shared visual pattern.
blocks.zh: ISSBA [Li等,2021]使用编码器-解码器网络将预先定义的信号嵌入到每个图像中. 这产生了无形的,具体实例的触发器,而不是单一的共享视觉模式.

blocks.en: TrojVLM [ Lyu et al., 2024 ] is tailored to vision-language generation. It uses a patch trigger and learns to insert the target phrase at a random position in the original response while preserving the surrounding clean content.
blocks.zh: TrojVLM [Lyu等, 2024] 为视觉语言生成所定制. 它使用补丁触发并学习在原响应中随机位置插入目标短语,同时保留周围的清洁内容.

blocks.en: VLOOD [ Lyu et al., 2025 ] is a VLM-specific attack that uses out-of-distribution auxiliary data and dedicated objectives to implant a backdoor while retaining the model’s clean knowledge. We use a patch-based trigger and replace the original response with the target response in our evaluated models.
blocks.zh: VLOOD [Lyu等,2025年]是一款VLM特有攻击,它使用外分配辅助数据和专用目标来植入后门而同时保留模型的清洁知识. 我们使用基于补丁的触发器,并用我们评价模型中的目标响应来取代原来的响应.

blocks.en: Appendix C Limitations and Scope
blocks.zh: 附录C 限制和范围

blocks.en: Our evaluation focuses on backdoors introduced by fine-tuning the visual-to-language projection interface while keeping the visual encoder and language model frozen. The effectiveness of PSR against backdoors introduced through other model components has not been evaluated. Applying PSR also requires access to the corresponding pretrained projection parameters and a small clean calibration set from the target task.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价重点是通过微调视觉到语言的投影界面,同时使视觉编码器和语言模型被冻结而引入的后门. 通过其他模型组件引入的PSR对后门的有效性尚未得到评价. 应用PSR还需要访问相应的预先训练的投影参数和从目标任务中设定的小型清洁校正.

blocks.en: Our ablation study shows a trade-off between backdoor suppression and clean-task performance: increasing the restoration ratio further reduces attack success but also degrades clean-task utility in the evaluated settings. In addition, our experiments cover two VLM architectures and two tasks, image captioning and visual question answering. Whether these findings extend to other architectures and tasks remains to be investigated.
blocks.zh: 我们的消化研究显示了后门抑制和清洁任务性能之间的取舍:提高修复率会进一步降低攻击成功率,同时也会降低被评价环境中的清洁任务效用. 此外,我们的实验包括两个VLM架构和两个任务,图像字幕和视觉问答. 这些调查结果是否扩大到其他结构和任务仍有待调查。
